What We Do

Complete landscape care, start to finish

From landscape design and install to retaining walls, drainage, mulching, and lawn care, Max Care handles every stage so your Knoxville or East Tennessee property looks its best year after year.

Design

Turning your vision into a plan
  • Paver DesignCustom walkways, patios, and driveways designed to fit your space and style
  • Retaining Wall DesignFunctional, erosion-controlling walls that also add structure and visual interest
  • Fire Pit DesignGathering spaces designed for year-round outdoor living
  • Planting DesignThoughtful plant selection and layout based on your climate, sunlight, and maintenance preferences

Install

Bringing the plan to life
  • Plant InstallationProfessional planting of trees, shrubs, and flowers for healthy, long-term growth
  • Mulch InstallationFresh mulch to protect soil, suppress weeds, and finish your beds
  • Rock & Stone InstallationDecorative rock, gravel, and stone for drainage, pathways, or low-maintenance beds
  • Down Spouts & French DrainsFrench drain installation and downspout drainage solutions that move water away from your home and beds to fix yard drainage problems, pooling, and erosion

Maintenance

Keeping it looking its best
  • Seasonal Trimming & CleanupRegular upkeep to keep your landscape neat through every season
  • Tree Pruning & TreatmentExpert pruning and health treatments to keep trees strong and attractive
  • Lawn Care & MowingDependable lawn maintenance, mowing, and edging to keep your yard healthy and sharp all season
  • Mulching & Fall CleanupFresh mulching service plus fall lawn care and leaf cleanup to protect beds and prep your landscape for the seasons ahead

About Us

A knack for this, since before he could drive

Max was mowing lawns and shaping beds before most kids his age were old enough to have a paper route. What started as an early feel for the work — the kind you can't really teach — turned into a full career built one yard at a time.

That hands-on experience is still the foundation of every project Max Care takes on today. But the part he actually enjoys most is earlier than that: sitting down with a client, hearing what they picture when they look out their back door, and figuring out how to get them there.

A consultation isn't a formality here — it's where the project actually starts. Getting on the same page before anything gets drawn or dug is what makes the rest of the process go smoothly, and it's what turns a client's vision into something real.

FAQ

Landscaping in Knoxville & East Tennessee: common questions

Answers for homeowners and businesses looking for a dependable, locally owned landscaper and lawn care team.

Are you a locally owned landscaping company in Knoxville?
Yes. Max Care Landscaping is a locally owned and operated landscaping company based in Knoxville, TN, serving homeowners and businesses throughout East Tennessee.
What landscaping services do you offer?
We handle landscape design and install, retaining wall construction, French drain installation, downspout and yard drainage solutions, mulching, planting, tree pruning, and seasonal lawn maintenance and fall lawn care.
How do I get a landscaping quote in Knoxville?
Request a free, no-obligation estimate using the form on this page, or call or text us. Most quote requests get a response within one business day.
Do you offer affordable lawn care?
We tailor every project to your goals and budget and provide clear, upfront estimates, so you know what to expect with no surprises.
Are you the same company as “Max Ball Landscaping”?
Yes. Some people search for us as “Max Ball Landscaping,” but our name is Max Care Landscaping. Either way, you have found the right local team.
